excerpt.zh: 经过初步探测，我们在求救频率中发现了异常的信号。
excerpt.en: Our initial scans have caught an irregular signal reminiscent of our own distress patterns.

texts.zh: 经过初步探测，我们在求救频率中发现了异常的信号。
texts.en: Our initial scans have caught an irregular signal reminiscent of our own distress patterns.

sections.zh: 经过初步探测，我们在求救频率中发现了异常的信号。
sections.en: Our initial scans have caught an irregular signal reminiscent of our own distress patterns.

texts.zh: 我们接收到的信号来自于一艘围绕[From.GetName]旋转的舰船。这艘船现在没有任何热成像，似乎是在漂浮。我们已经制定了一个特殊项目来调查船员的遭遇。
texts.en: The signal we intercepted was a distress call from a ship in orbit around [From.GetName]. The ship is not giving off any heat signatures and seems to be drifting. A Special Project has been issued to investigate what has happened to the crew.

label.en: We don't have time for this.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh: 一条舰船漂浮在太空中，没有信号交互。更仔细的检查也许能弄清她的船员遭遇了些什么。
texts.en: A ship adrift in space, no signals going in or coming out. Inspecting it more closely might shed some light on what has happened to the crew.

texts.zh: 围绕[From.From.From.GetName]运行的舰船并没有被遗弃。上面的船员还活着，但是状态不好。他们受到了某种脑寄生虫的影响。我们的科学家能够轻松地治愈他们。
texts.en: The ship in orbit around [From.From.From.GetName] was not abandoned. The crew is alive, but not well, influenced by some sort of brain parasite. With the help of our scientists they could easily be cured.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh: 舰上的船员已经全部丧生。更令人不安的是，他们似乎是被某种高度发达的脑寄生虫杀死的。它们寄生在船员的脑子里并使其疯狂。多亏了科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]及时发现，我们的船员才没有被感染。
texts.en: The crew of the ship has been found dead. What is more disturbing is that they appear to have been killed by some highly advanced brain parasites, which infested them and drove them mad. Thanks to Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName]'s findings we were able to protect our own crew from being infected!

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的首都的名称。
note.en: In the game, your capital's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现科学官的名字。
note.en: In the game, the science officer's name appears here.

texts.zh: 在调查飞船和船员的残骸后，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]推测船员们一定是自相残杀。太空旅行的孤独与禁闭甚至可以击溃最强大的意志。
texts.en: Having searched the ship and inspected the crew's remains, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has deduced that the crewmembers must have killed each other. The solitude and confinement of space travel can break even the strongest of minds.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现科学官的名字。
note.en: In the game, the science officer's name appears here.

texts.zh: 我们从[Root.GetName]收到了求救信号。船员开始发疯地互相残杀！舰长已经失去控制，派船救援已经来不及了。这和他们刚刚调查的古船有关吗？
texts.en: We are receiving a distress signal from the [Root.GetName]. The crew has gone mad and are killing each other! The captain has lost all control, sending help would be futile at this point. Could this have anything to do with that derelict ship they recently investigated?

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这艘舰船的名称。
note.en: In the game, the ship's name appears here.

note.zh: 我方科研船与科学家损失。
note.en: Our science ship and scientist are lost.

summary.text:
# 求救信号 / Distress Signal

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)
- 来源 Sources：`common/anomalies/02_anomaly_categories.txt:32-54` · `events/anomaly_events_3.txt:104-271 (4010-4012)` · `common/special_projects/00_projects_3.txt:2-42` · `events/failures.txt:137-160, 579-600`
- 审阅 Review：2026-10-12（c3b-exploration）· 已审阅 Reviewed

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 2级异常；在苔原或寒冷贫瘠行星上以权重3生成；机械帝国权重0。  
  Level-2 anomaly; spawn weight 3 on tundra or cold barren planets; weight 0 for machine empires.
- 4010 立即安排15天后的通用联络报告（共享枢纽）。  
  4010 schedules a generic contact report 15 days later (shared hub).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 4010“迷失太空”：一艘漂流飞船发出求救信号。调查 → 20天项目“废弃舰船”（科研船+科学家）；或无暇理会。  
  4010 "Lost in Space": a drifting ship sends a distress call. Investigate (20-day project) or ignore it.
- 项目完成按权重：20 4012（船员被脑寄生虫控制但仍活着；若还有未接触的帝国才可能）、50 4011（船员已死，学会防护；进化掠食者可把尸体送回）、30 anomaly_failure.4011（船员互相残杀），后者10天后 anomaly_failure.4012：我方科研船船员也发疯，船毁人亡。  
  Project result by weight: 20 4012 (crew alive under a brain parasite; only if an uncontacted empire exists), 50 4011 (crew dead; we learn to protect ourselves; Evolutionary Predators may send the corpses home), 30 anomaly_failure.4011 (they killed each other), which leads 10 days later to anomaly_failure.4012: our own crew goes mad and the ship is destroyed.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 4012：救助他们 → 与10跳外一个尚未接触的帝国建立通讯并获好感（1天后进入通用首次通讯事件 action.1，另一故事）；或任其死亡。  
  4012: help them → communications with an uncontacted empire at least 10 jumps away and its goodwill (the generic contact event action.1 follows a day later, another story); or let them perish.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无特别差异。  
  No notable variants.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：类别、4010–4012、项目随机表与两个失败事件。  
  Category, 4010–4012, the project random list and both failure events.
- 覆盖 Coverage：7 个文档全部核对 / all 7 docs checked.
